safe_claims: S.4822 passed the full Senate by voice vote June 17, 2026 (GovInfo, primary).

OOI data feeds the ocean models used in NOAA/UAF fisheries stock assessments.
verified.industry_consequence: Alaska fisheries managers and seafood operators retain the real-time ocean data underpinning catch-limit science; risk deferred pending an NSF expert-panel review.

verified.story_title: Alaska has no statewide data-center regulatory framework; SB 250 grid-cost-protection bill died in committee (Landye Bennett Blumstein analysis, June 18)
safe_claims: Per a June 18 Landye Bennett Blumstein LLP analysis, Alaska has no specific statewide data-center regulations.
SB 250, which would have required data centers to cover grid-infrastructure costs and power-cost increases attributable to them, died in committee in May 2026 (LBB).
No Alaska statute requires data centers to cover incremental grid-upgrade costs (LBB).
ATTRIBUTE all claims to Landye Bennett Blumstein. STRIP the GVEA 20.7 c/kWh figure; not on the LBB page.
verified.industry_consequence: Developers must self-fund grid-upgrade agreements with Chugach or GVEA; site-selection risk favors off-Railbelt and on-base sites with dedicated on-site generation.

verified.story_title: Federal court strikes the $100K H-1B fee; Alaska rural districts stay wary of resuming international-teacher hiring
safe_claims: A federal court struck down the $100,000 H-1B fee (ruling June 8); Alaska reporting June 14-15 (ADN, KYUK).
Alaska employs 341 H-1B teachers of ~574 international teachers (ADN).
Bering Strait: 86 of 134 teachers international (64%), 72 on H-1B; Kashunamiut: 14 of 18 (78%) (ADN).
Districts say they can't risk new sponsorships if the government appeals (KYUK).
verified.industry_consequence: Alaska rural districts face a fall-2026 hiring decision under appeal risk; the in-state STEM and special-ed teacher pipeline stays constrained.

Deficits: ASD ~$90M, Mat-Su ~$28M, Kenai ~$8.5M, Ketchikan ~$3M.

verified.industry_consequence: The education-workforce contraction narrows the in-state STEM and technical talent pipeline feeding UAF/UAA and downstream energy, healthcare, and defense employers.
